correctness.rationale: From iterated Schwarz f=z^m g, |g|<=1, at |z|²=s the quotient is in a disk with center q=1/(1+s+...+s^m), radius q*s^((m+1)/2). AM–GM on the m terms s,...,s^m gives radius <= (1-q)/m, the Minkowski interpolation radius between {1} and target disk center/radius 1/(m+1). f=z^m sweeps the entire fixed-radius boundary and as s->1 approaches the full target circle, whereas at z=0 equals 1. Support is max(cos(theta),(1+cos(theta))/(m+1)). Tangency geometry gives exact stated formulas; the m>=2 restriction is essential for the full boundary sweep. Reconstructed algebra and checked independent rational AM–GM and tangency identities; finite checks do not prove all m.
